title: Online Excel Editor — Edit XLSX Workbooks in Your Browser
description: Online Excel workbook editor powered by OnlyOffice. Sign in to sync .xlsx files to your account, open them anywhere, and autosave as you work. Local editing still available without an account.
ogDescription: Edit Excel workbooks online — sign in to sync .xlsx to your account, or open a file locally in the browser.
badge: Local free · No Office install · Cloud $5/year
sub: Open a local .xlsx free — no account, editing stays in your tab. Cloud sync is $5 a year when the same workbook needs to follow you across devices.

features.h2: Say goodbye to bloated suites. Welcome to focused productivity.
features.p: OnlyOffice in the tab for free local edits. Sign in only when you want the same workbook on every device — $5 a year, not another heavy suite.

items.p: Formulas, charts, sheets and formatting via OnlyOffice WebAssembly — no desktop Office required.
Open a file on this device with no account. Edits stay in the tab; optional seven-day recovery copies stay in this browser.

items.h3: Cloud sync when you need it
items.p: For $5 a year, workbooks in your account travel with you. Start on one device, continue on another.

essentials.p: Built for opening attachments, fixing cells, and keeping formulas intact — not for replacing every Excel power feature.

items.label: Honest fit
items.p: Great for open–edit–download and light formulas. For VBA macros, heavy Power Query, or live multi-user co-editing, stick with Excel or Google Sheets.

items.label: Organization
items.p: Spreadsheets are the product. The same engine still opens Word, PowerPoint, PDF and OpenDocument when you need them.

items.label: Cloud library
items.p: Sign in once for $5 a year. Browse, open, and autosave .xlsx files in your account — then pick up on another device.

items.label: Offline ready
items.p: Once editor assets are cached, keep editing a local file without the network. Cloud save waits until you are online.

band.h2: Ready for a faster, lighter spreadsheet workflow?
band.p: Open a local .xlsx free. Add cloud sync for $5 a year only when the workbook needs to follow you.

foot.blurb: The lightweight online Excel and document editor — local editing free, cloud sync when you sign in.

faqLd.a: No for local editing. Open a .xlsx free without signing in — the file stays in your browser tab. Sign in only for cloud workbooks ($5/year) so the same file follows you across devices.

faqLd.q: What happens if I close the tab?
faqLd.a: Signed-in workbooks are written back by save and autosave. Separately, local recovery copies can stay in this browser for 7 days — see the history page. Cloud files remain in your account.

faqLd.q: Is this a full Excel replacement?
faqLd.a: No. It is built for opening attachments, everyday formulas, and format-preserving edits without installing Office. For VBA macros, heavy Power Query, or live multi-user co-editing, use Excel or Google Sheets.
Excel (.xlsx) is the primary product. The same editor also opens Word (DOCX), PowerPoint (PPTX), PDF and CSV, powered by OnlyOffice in WebAssembly.
